name: Harry Reid International

runway.v: four runways; the longest, 8L/26R, is 14,515 ft × 150 ft (about 4,424 m × 46 m); 8R/26L 10,526 ft, 1R/19L 9,771 ft, 1L/19R 8,988 ft, all 150 ft wide

hours.v: airport attended at all hours; tower 24 hours; ramp control 05:00–01:00 local
hours.quote: All Months, All Days, All Hours

noise.v: turbojet departures not permitted on runways 1R/19L or 1L/19R from 20:00 to 08:00 (time basis not stated), except for weather or operational need; minimal power on some departures
noise.quote: TBJT DEPS NOT PMTD ON RWY 01R/19L OR RWY 01L/19R 2000-0800. XCPNS FOR WX OR OPNL NECESSITY.

customs.v: CBP general aviation clearance (Pacific Time office): Sun, Tue, Thu, Fri 09:00–11:00; Mon, Wed, Sat 09:00–11:00 and 17:00–21:00; phone CBP at least 2 hours before arrival; user fee decal needed; the AIP says GA CBP reservations at least 12 hours ahead

ppr.v: all non-standard runway operations and use of taxiway H by aircraft with wingspan over 135 ft need PPR from the Department of Aviation
ppr.quote: ALL NON-STD RWY OPNS PPR FM DEPT OF AVN.

handling.v: general aviation parking very limited; check availability with either FBO before the trip
handling.quote: GA PRKG VERY LTD. FOR PRKG AVAILABILITY CTC EITHER FBO (702) 736-1830 OR (702) 739-1100.

notes: US AIP Part 3 AD 2 Nevada, HTML, read 28 Oct 2026 (amendment shown on page not stated; 29th edition effective 22 Jan 2026, Amendment 1 dated 9 Jul 2026 published). The AIP heading reads 'Harry Reid International' but a block below still says 'Mc Carran Intl'. The 2000-0800 turbojet line has no L or Z; recorded as noise, not a curfew. CBP fact sheet 8 Aug 2024; the AIP adds that GA CBP reservations are required at least 12 hours ahead ('GA CBP RSVNS ARE RQRD TO BE SMTD A MIN OF 12 HOURS IN ADVN'), which is stricter than the CBP sheet's 2 hours; follow the stricter. ft to m conversion mine (1 ft = 0.3048 m).
